node.title: L1 marked constant-shift extremal kernel normal form
node.statement: At the upper survivor endpoint T=2m in marked degree strip m, exact saturation forces the 2m by 2(m+1) constant-shift coefficient matrix to have rank exactly 2m. Every kernel basis is a pair of degree-at-most-m polynomial columns with determinant kappa product_i(Z-a_i), and the enlarged numerator/denominator have a unique two-generator reconstruction whose coefficient gcd divides the mark locator J. The adjugate recovers both coefficients after multiplication by the complete quotient locator. Explicit saturated full-petal examples F=1+lambda X^cV(P), W=U(P) exist in every strip, so the 2m+1 exclusion threshold is sharp and the endpoint must be priced rather than excluded.
